description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set” shows how the combined training set is divided among 13 labeled data sources, with each slice annotated by a label and percentage via leader lines (no separate legend is shown). The largest slice is NQ in medium blue at about 31.3%. Other sizable slices include FEVER in teal at about 16.1%, SNLI in orange at about 15.4%, VITAMINC in light cyan at about 13.0%, and MULTINLI in salmon/pink at about 11.3%. Smaller slices include ANLI in orange-brown at about 4.6%, FACTCC in green at about 2.6%, ENTFA in yellow at about 1.8%, SCITAIL in light green at about 1.2%, PUBHEALTH in pale yellow at about 0.5%, MULTIFC in light blue at about 0.5%, SCIFACT in very light gray/blue at about 0.1%, and XSUMHUL as a very thin light-colored slice (percentage not visibly printed). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
